test_cases.name: proves server-derived client ownership: a design URL alone cannot select a client
test_cases.assertion: rejects crossClientRequest with FOREIGN_CLIENT_DENIAL error code

test_cases.name: rejects foreign or unknown design IDs: cannot spoof or mismatch design ID
test_cases.assertion: rejects unknownDesignRequest with UNKNOWN_DESIGN_DENIAL error code

test_cases.name: rejects stale requests via optimistic locking: expected version must match current binding version
test_cases.assertion: rejects staleRequest with STALE_VERSION_CONFLICT error code and retryable=true

test_cases.name: strictly enforces snapshot completeness: incomplete snapshot cannot be represented as fully observed source
test_cases.assertion: rejects incompleteRequest with INCOMPLETE_SNAPSHOT_ERROR error code

test_cases.name: accepts valid, fully-observed capture sets satisfying all invariants
